source: Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University — UAS Research Guide
description: Open / publicly accessible UAS resources mined from the ERAU guide's Websites and Journals tabs (the Databases tab is cataloged separately in erau_databases.json). Each entry is tagged with the ecosystem repos that could consume it. Only non-paywalled resources are included here.

resources.name: FAA UAS Accident & Incident Reports (ASIAS)
resources.notes: Queryable database of UAS accidents/incidents from 2010 on. Mineable for a safety/incident corpus in the handbook's grayzone/field sections.

resources.name: FAA Drones Portal
resources.notes: Authoritative US UAS rules hub (Part 107, registration, B4UFLY). Anchor reference for compliance/regulatory pages.

resources.name: FAA UAS Regulations & Policy Library
resources.notes: CFRs, advisory circulars, orders. Mineable for a citable regulatory index.

resources.name: FAA Small UAS Rule (Part 107 rulemaking)
resources.notes: Federal Register provides a public JSON/API for documents — directly mineable.

resources.name: NCSL — Current Unmanned Aircraft State Law Landscape
resources.notes: State-by-state UAS legislation tracker. Useful for a US state-law matrix.

resources.name: AUVSI
resources.notes: Primary unmanned-systems industry association. Reference + Blue UAS/Green UAS cross-links.

resources.name: ASSURE (Alliance for System Safety of UAS through Research Excellence)
resources.notes: FAA UAS Center of Excellence; 23 universities. Source of public research reports.

resources.name: SKYbrary — Unmanned Aerial Systems
resources.notes: Wiki-style safety reference with policy links; structured enough to mine for definitions/policy.

resources.name: Eurocontrol UAS
resources.notes: European airspace integration. International regulatory context.

resources.name: UK Civil Aviation Authority — Drones
resources.notes: UK regulatory guidance. International compliance reference.

resources.name: European Cockpit Association — Drone Integration
resources.notes: Incident-focused campaign on safe drone integration.

resources.name: UAS Magazine (archives)
resources.notes: Open-access trade publication (civil/ag/defense/commercial). Mineable for news/trends feed.

resources.name: International Journal of Intelligent Unmanned Systems
Journal of Unmanned Vehicle Systems
resources.notes: Canadian Science Publishing. Citation reference only (paywalled).
